title: The Spillway Stair
description: Thirty-four limestone risers in two flights connect ground to a six-metre upper terrace.

review.notes: Extra round (stair only), checked against the two round-3 points. (1) Paving pits: fixed. The evenly spaced dark pit pattern is gone; the slabs vary in size and joint layout, and the wear shows as chipped nosings and a few cracks (hero.jpg, closeup_upper). (2) Ground skirt: fixed. An irregular soil and turf apron with grass sprigs now runs round the whole base, so the stair no longer stands on the ground plane with a hard edge (hero.jpg, turn_200, turn_290, closeup_base). Polish, not blocking: the apron is flat and evenly thin with sparse sprigs, and the soil does not rise against the wall feet; there are small dark slits under the top coping (closeup_base); the right flank is still a stepped stack of pilaster boxes.
